title: Tensor arithmetic
summary: Operators can work element by element on matching tensor shapes.
introduction: Operators can work element by element on matching tensor shapes. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Operators can work element by element on matching tensor shapes.

blocks.code:
import tensorflow as tf

a = tf.constant([1, 2])
b = tf.constant([3, 4])
print((a + b).numpy().tolist())
blocks.title: Tensor arithmetic

blocks.text: The output is [4, 6]. Matching positions are added.

blocks.text: Element-wise multiplication is different from matrix multiplication.
